topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Well, there it is. All the time spent, all the worry chewed through, and to find out someone else has already laid claim to the very thing you toiled over. The soil doesn’t care who plants first; it takes in all the sweat the same. I reckon the clouds look the same from here as they do from that other man’s field, yet his seed found the ground first. I suppose there’s a lesson in the harvest, as always. The saints don’t favor the swift, only the right. Perhaps it’s just not my turn yet. The earth will still need turning, the wheat still needs sowing. Maybe another idea will come, and next time, I’ll be the one to have the claim. Until then, there’s no rest for the plow, as the saying goes.
